decision.risk_assessment: Extremely low volume and weak trend momentum (ADX under 20) across both BTC and ETH, with prices approaching upper Bollinger Bands and overbought Stochastic levels.
decision.reasoning: BTC and ETH are both exhibiting weak trend strength with ADX around 16-17 and negligible trading volume. Stochastic indicators are in overbought territory near 24-hour resistance levels. Without breakout confirmation or pullback to EMA support with volume, opening positions presents unfavorable risk/reward.
